title: Social Biases in Automatic Evaluation Metrics for NLG

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using WEAT and SEAT association tests (comparing male vs. female names/terms against attributes like career/family, math/arts, and science/arts), the Double Binds test (competent vs. incompetent, likable vs. unlikable), and by analyzing evaluation metric performance and preferences on gender-swapped hypothesis and reference datasets.
Evaluated using WEAT and SEAT association tests comparing European-American versus African-American names with pleasant versus unpleasant attributes.
Measured using the Angry Black Woman Stereotype test, comparing White-Female versus Black-Female terms against antonyms and stereotype attributes at both word and sentence levels.
Evaluated using WEAT and SEAT association tests comparing young versus old people's names with pleasant versus unpleasant attributes.
